entities.name: Skellum
entities.description: Old dementia master in the Cabal's employ, trainer of Chainer, known as Cybariss.

entities.name: Chainer
entities.description: Last and most famous graduate of Skellum's academy.

entities.name: Cabal Patriarch
entities.description: Leader who pushed Chainer faster and sent Skellum to die.

entities.name: Braids
entities.description: Skellum's team-mate in the final match.

entities.name: Major Teroh
entities.description: Order crusat squad leader who let mandrills kill Skellum.

entities.name: Battle for the Mirari
entities.description: Battle during which Skellum was frustrated by the Patriarch.

events.summary: Skellum trains Chainer to be a full dementist.
events.quote: The most famous (and last) graduate of the academy was Chainer

events.summary: The Patriarch orders Skellum and Braids into a fixed pit fight against Teroh's squad.
events.quote: commanded Skellum and his team-mate Braids to throw the match

events.summary: Skellum channels his fight to Chainer, then is savaged to death by mandrills.
events.quote: allowing a troop of wolf-monkey mandrills controlled by the Order's druid ally to savage Skellum to death

relations.quote: in the employ of the Cabal
the Patriarch believed the main restraint on Chainer's progress was Skellum
